live_ui.evidence: Explicit metadata and caption actions against one existing live YouTube source; no new search or model work. Embedded preview tested as a user-requested frame, not a playback-quality claim.

notes: All 74 unique mocked browser cases pass across the recorded runs. One Chromium context crashed during initial navigation in the final 15-case run; that case passed its isolated recheck.

The first description-recovery run reproduced a remaining reader CSS clamp (2 of 3 passed). Scoped base/expanded overrides fixed it; final 3 of 3 passed. An initial reader test helper used an outdated eye-button label; corrected final 3 of 3 passed.
Initial sandboxed backend checks could not bind loopback test ports. The final full suite ran with local networking and passed 317 tests; one pre-existing test was skipped.

Actual saved-live UI used one metadata-only request and one caption-only request (four upstream attempts), recovered 133 caption segments, and validated thumbnail intent. No new search, model generation or budget increase occurred.
Owned idle application restarted with current ignored env; frontend/core/nine provider health checks pass and model ledger/state are preserved. No commit or push was performed.
